mapper.insert:
insert into CHINAMUTUALFUNDNAV (OBJECT_ID, F_INFO_WINDCODE, ANN_DATE, PRICE_DATE, F_NAV_UNIT, F_NAV_ACCUMULATED, F_NAV_DIVACCUMULATED, F_NAV_ADJFACTOR, CRNCY_CODE, F_PRT_NETASSET, F_ASSET_MERGEDSHARESORNOT, NETASSET_TOTAL, F_NAV_ADJUSTED, OPDATE, OPMODE) values
(#{item.objectId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.fInfoWindcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.annDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.priceDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.fNavUnit,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.fNavAccumulated,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.fNavDivaccumulated,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.fNavAdjfactor,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.crncyCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.fPrtNetasset,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.fAssetMergedsharesornot,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.netassetTotal,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.fNavAdjusted,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.opdate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{item.opmode,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: select A.OBJECT_ID, A.F_INFO_WINDCODE, date_format(STR_TO_DATE(A.ANN_DATE,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') ANN_DATE, date_format(STR_TO_DATE(A.PRICE_DATE,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') PRICE_DATE, A.F_NAV_UNIT, A.F_NAV_ACCUMULATED, A.F_NAV_DIVACCUMULATED, A.F_NAV_ADJFACTOR, A.CRNCY_CODE, A.F_PRT_NETASSET, A.F_ASSET_MERGEDSHARESORNOT,A.NETASSET_TOTAL, A.F_NAV_ADJUSTED from CHINAMUTUALFUNDNAV A WHERE EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_PRODUCT B WHERE B.FINPROD_TYPE='F06' AND A.F_INFO_WINDCODE = B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND B.PROFIT_TYPE != '03' ) AND A.F_NAV_UNIT IS NOT NULL AND A.ANN_DATE = #{cdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
